status_summary: Executive Order 14213, signed 2025-02-14 (90 FR 9945), established the National Energy Dominance Council in the Executive Office of the President, chaired by the Secretary of the Interior with the Secretary of Energy as Vice Chair, and directed it to provide the President a recommended National Energy Dominance Strategy, without a set deadline. The order mentions critical minerals and national security but not energy security, cyber or physical threats, the DOE Office of Policy or the National Security Strategy. No published energy dominance or energy security strategy, and no DOE Office of Policy energy security strategy, was found. The directed strategy is a White House council product on energy dominance rather than the DOE-prepared energy security strategy the Mandate describes.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14213 was signed, establishing the National Energy Dominance Council with the Secretary of Energy as Vice Chair and directing it to provide a recommended National Energy Dominance Strategy.

title: Develop a National Energy Security Strategy through DOE's Office of Policy
uncertainties: Executive Order 14213 was read in full on the Federal Register host. The White House fact sheet appeared in search results but was not opened. Absence of a published strategy rests on the researcher's searches, an earlier reviewer web search and one further web search in this review; a White House proclamation of 2026-10-07 on energy dominance, read on whitehouse.gov, lists energy actions but mentions no National Energy Dominance Strategy or council output. Executive Orders 14154 and 14156 were not read for strategy directions, and FY2027 budget language and DOE Office of Policy outputs were not checked.
